name: Australian Pacific Coal Limited
summary: Australian Pacific Coal Limited acquires, explores for, develops, and produces thermal and metallurgical coal prospects in Australia. The company primarily holds interests in the Dartbrook project covering a total of 3,268 hectares located in the coal region of the Hunter Valley, New South Wales; and various coal tenements in the Bowen, Surat, Galilee, and Clarence-Moreton basins, Queensland. Australian Pacific Coal Limited is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
